name: nctinv_nctstat
expr: x = nctinv(p, nu, delta); [m, v] = nctstat(nu, delta); [m5, v5] = nctstat(5, 1.5); rt = nctcdf(x, nu, delta); rt_err = max(abs(rt - p)); central = nctinv(0.7, 10, 0); central_t = tinv(0.7, 10);
comment: Sig: nctinv(p, nu, delta) — inverse cdf via Newton on nctcdf with central tinv shifted by delta as warm start, safeguarded by bracketing bisection. nctstat(nu, delta) — closed form m = δ √(ν/2) Γ((ν-1)/2)/Γ(ν/2) for ν > 1; v = ν(1+δ²)/(ν-2) - m² for ν > 2; NaN otherwise. Verified bit-equal to MATLAB R2025b at tol=1e-8. KNOWN GAPs: nctrnd next batch.
